headline: Pakistan and China agreed to accelerate talks on a gasoline import arrangement and a proposed LPG plant, the petroleum ministry said, Arab News reports.

card.kicker: Petrol Aur LPG Plant Par Baat
card.desc: Petrol import aur LPG plant par baat cheet tez karne ka faisla

caption:
Petrol aur LPG par Pakistan aur China ki baat cheet tez! ⛽
Arab News ke mutabiq Petroleum Ministry ne Wednesday ko bataya ke Pakistan aur China ne petrol (gasoline) import ke intezam aur khana pakane aur garmi ke liye ek LPG plant ki tajweez par muzakrat tez karne par ittefaq kiya hai. Wafaqi Wazir-e-Petroleum Ali Pervaiz Malik ne Chinese Safeer Jiang Zaidong se mulaqat ke baad kaha ke hum baat cheet se aage barh kar amal chahte hain. Dono mulk ek joint commercial team banayenge, aur Pakistan State Oil ko storage aur terminals ke liye mumkina partner kaha gaya hai. Yeh qadam US-Iran jang se Gulf ki fuel supply mutasir hone ke baad uthaya ja raha hai. Petrol ki miqdar, qeemat aur LPG plant ki jagah abhi nahi batayi gayi.
Kya is se Pakistan mein fuel ki supply behtar hogi? Comment mein batayein 👇
